title: Run Summary
description: Compact representation of one tailoring run for list/inbox views. Derived from data/runs/<run_id>/state.json on backend; served by GET /api/runs.

ui_status.description: Pre-computed status for UI rendering. Wave 4 Step A: prefers confidence_tier when match_scores present. needs_rewrite indicates Tier 2/3 deep rewrite would help. Wave 4 D.5: pending_human_verify means Pass 3 flagged unsourced claims and the user must decide per-claim (approve / reject / edit) before submit; degraded_to_manual stays on verify (operator-side fallback, no per-claim breakdown to act on). Gate 1 (v0.6.1, R-18): degraded_no_substance means the run completed without exception but failed the substance floor (<3 of 5 LLM-driven sub-skills produced non-fallback output OR <2 change_cards OR no LLM-driven change_card). UI must surface a banner explaining which sub-skills fell back and disable Submit; this is distinct from `failed` (hard crash) and `verify` (operator caution).

narration.description: Short first-person sentence summarizing the run (e.g. 'I tailored this 2 min ago. C 产品运营 lens, 3 项目命中 AIGC.'). Backend generates from the run's events array. Used directly as DraftCard.narration.

confidence_tier.description: Per ARCHITECTURE.md §7a 3-tier verdict. Computed in repl/loop.py via tier1/verdict_scorer.score_run from resume_match_score + degradation_events + lens routing confidence. UI renders as a colored badge (green / yellow / red). Until Wave 4's Pass A→B→C selector ships, this is a closed-form approximation; method='tier1_approximation' in the full match_scores dict on the run-detail endpoint.

resume_match_score.description: Mean over user's experiences of vertical_fit_per_lens[primary_lens] mapped to Cat-points (core=100, adjacent=75, weak=40, missing=0). 0..100 scale per ARCHITECTURE.md §7b.

lifecycle_state.description: Current job lifecycle state per ARCHITECTURE.md §6 + Wave 4 Step C state machine. Surfaced from state.lifecycle.current_state. Defaults to 'tailored' for runs with verdict=complete.
